doc.brief: The QAbstractSpinBox class provides a spinbox and a line edit to display values.
doc.index_brief: Spinbox and a line edit to display values

QAbstractSpinBox(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs an abstract spinbox with the given *parent* with default [wrapping](xref:qt:QAbstractSpinBox), and [alignment](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/stylesheet-reference.html#alignment) properties.

QAbstractSpinBox::ButtonSymbols buttonSy.brief: This property holds the current button symbol mode

QAbstractSpinBox::CorrectionMode correct.brief: This property holds the mode to correct an [Intermediate](xref:qt:QValidator) value if editing finishes

QAbstractSpinBox::StepEnabled stepEnable.brief: Virtual function that determines whether stepping up and down is legal at any given time.

QLineEdit * lineEdit() const.brief: This function returns a pointer to the line edit of the spin box.

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QSize sizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::sizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QString specialValueText() const.brief: This property holds the special-value text

QString text() const.brief: This property holds the spin box's text, including any prefix and suffix

QValidator::State validate(QString &inpu.brief: This virtual function is called by the [QAbstractSpinBox](xref:qt:QAbstractSpinBox) to determine whether *input* is valid.

Qt::Alignment alignment() const.brief: This property holds the alignment of the spin box

bool hasAcceptableInput() const.brief: This property holds whether the input satisfies the current validation

bool hasFrame() const.brief: This property holds whether the spin box draws itself with a frame

bool isAccelerated() const.brief: This property holds whether the spin box will accelerate the frequency of the steps when pressing the step Up/Down buttons.

bool isGroupSeparatorShown() const.brief: This property holds whether a thousands separator is enabled.

bool isReadOnly() const.brief: This property holds whether the spin box is read only.

bool keyboardTracking() const.brief: This property holds whether keyboard tracking is enabled for the spinbox.

bool wrapping() const.brief: This property holds whether the spin box is circular.

void clear().brief: Clears the lineedit of all text but prefix and suffix.

void editingFinished().brief: This signal is emitted editing is finished.

void fixup(QString &input) const.brief: This virtual function is called by the [QAbstractSpinBox](xref:qt:QAbstractSpinBox) if the *input* is not validated to [QValidator::Acceptable](xref:qt:QValidator) when Return is pressed or...

void initStyleOption(QStyleOptionSpinBox.brief: Initialize *option* with the values from this [QSpinBox](xref:qt:QSpinBox).

void interpretText().brief: This function interprets the text of the spin box.

void returnPressed().brief: This signal is emitted when the Return or Enter key is used.

void selectAll().brief: Selects all the text in the spinbox except the prefix and suffix.

void setAccelerated(bool on).brief: This property holds whether the spin box will accelerate the frequency of the steps when pressing the step Up/Down buttons.

void setAlignment(Qt::Alignment flag).brief: This property holds the alignment of the spin box

void setButtonSymbols(QAbstractSpinBox::.brief: This property holds the current button symbol mode

void setCorrectionMode(QAbstractSpinBox:.brief: This property holds the mode to correct an [Intermediate](xref:qt:QValidator) value if editing finishes

void setFrame(bool).brief: This property holds whether the spin box draws itself with a frame

void setGroupSeparatorShown(bool shown).brief: This property holds whether a thousands separator is enabled.

void setKeyboardTracking(bool kt).brief: This property holds whether keyboard tracking is enabled for the spinbox.

void setLineEdit(QLineEdit *lineEdit).brief: Sets the line edit of the spinbox to be *lineEdit* instead of the current line edit widget. *lineEdit* cannot be `nullptr`.

void setReadOnly(bool r).brief: This property holds whether the spin box is read only.

void setSpecialValueText(const QString &.brief: This property holds the special-value text

void setWrapping(bool w).brief: This property holds whether the spin box is circular.

void stepBy(int steps).brief: Virtual function that is called whenever the user triggers a step.

void stepDown().brief: Steps down by one linestep Calling this slot is analogous to calling [stepBy](xref:qt:QAbstractSpinBox)(-1);

void stepUp().brief: Steps up by one linestep Calling this slot is analogous to calling [stepBy](xref:qt:QAbstractSpinBox)(1);
